verifier_note: Re-fetched the Wayback captures: Citta Sant'Angelo (2026-04-15) and Giugliano (2026-02-12) store pages are live with hours, and the Rimini city page (2025-09-14) lists Corso d'Augusto 138. claim: AGAINST: in an Oct-2025 interview, FL's VP for Iberia, Laura Lopez, said FL ran 60 Iberian stores (mostly in malls) and about 800 staff, with its regional HQ in Barcelona. She said Iberia is one of FL's European 'big six', behind Italy and France, and that Iberia plus France add up to 217 stores. FL planned new Iberian openings ('we have prepared a list of cities and strategic markets'), would gradually refit the entire Iberian network to the Reimagined concept (Barcelona Diagonal Mar, end-Sep 2025, was the first post-integration opening), and would 'continue to focus on the physical store ... independently'. She said DKS planned, for now, to strengthen FL in Europe rather than bring the DICK'S brand there.
data_point: Iberia 60 stores, ~800 employees; Iberia+France 217 stores; 80% of sales footwear; new openings budget-dependent
source_name: Modaes (Celia Oliveras), Spanish original + English edition modaes.com/global
original_quote: Dependera del presupuesto global que se destine, pero tenemos preparada una lista por ciudades y mercados estrategicos
english_translation: It will depend on the overall budget allocated, but we have prepared a list of cities and strategic markets
verifier_note: Fetched both editions (200). Byline Celia Oliveras, dated 31 Oct 2025; every quoted element is present: 60 points of sale, big six, 217 with France, ~800 employees, Diagonal Mar, refit of the whole network, the 'independently' quote, and DKS strengthening FL in Europe. Not in the baseline or the confirmed files (C_w1_labor-rest only mentions Diagonal Mar as unverified). The scraper's implied France figure of ~157 (217-60) does not match the French locator's 149 at deal close (confirmed elsewhere), so the 217 likely uses a different scope or date. Openings were explicitly budget-contingent. Later locator data (Spain 52 to 46-48, PT 9) show the Iberian fleet shrinking, not growing, which makes this a stated plan that was overtaken.

The database cites 753 employees for 2026, and the company's national sales rank fell from #2,113 to #2,347.
data_point: Ventas 2024 EUR126,621,993; resultado EUR2,610,706; EBITDA EUR6,986,818; 753 employees (2026)
original_quote: Tiene un total de 753 (ano 2026) trabajadores en su plantilla.
english_translation: It has a total of 753 workers on staff (year 2026).
verifier_note: Could not verify: both elEconomista pages returned HTTP 429 on repeated tries, Wayback refused connections and Apify is over its limit. The infonif.economia3 profile I could open shows financials paywalled ('***'), shows 'approximately 94' employees (which conflicts with 753; definitions likely differ), and confirms the entity, the KPMG auditor and the Sigal appointment. The figures are pre-deal (FY2024) and transfer-priced statutory results, so they say little about the exit question. Downgraded to C.
